name: Session Chain Observer
description: Progressive-disclosure tools for observing and diagnosing agent session execution chains. Designed for skill-optimizer to analyze tool call patterns, errors, and performance.

maxStepsPerPage.description: Max steps returned per page in chain_steps. Default: 50.

maxDetailChars.description: Max chars for full tool output in chain_detail. Default: 8000.

summaryInputChars.description: Max chars for input summaries in chain_steps. Default: 120.

summaryOutputChars.description: Max chars for output summaries in chain_steps. Default: 200.
